Whoops! Looks like [[A Jedi's Focus]] didn't work too well for [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]. Fortunately, you won't have any trouble using it in your Jedi decks. With two stellar uses, nobody's going to flinch away from this card.

[[Scum And Villainy]] decks are wildly popular these days, but fortunately, [[A Jedi's Focus]] is here to keep them in check. As long as you have someone with a lightsaber in a battle, [[A Jedi's Focus]] cuts your opponent's aliens' power by 1, handy against so many of the high-power freaks that Dark Side players love so well. If you're facing a non-unique swarm, then [[A Jedi's Focus]] really comes in handy: all those generic aliens receive double the penalty. That's enough to negate the bonuses provided by most "reps," and positively demolishes most of the weaker non-uniques.

But that's not all! [[A Jedi's Focus]] is also splendid in duels. Since Jedi and Dark Jedi are roughly equal in duels, this card can tip the edge in your favor by adding the destiny number of the top card of your Lost Pile to your duel total. It doesn't matter if it's a 7 or a 1, every bit of extra power helps in a duel... especially an [[Epic Duel]]! Make [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] lose the pot, and you'll have no worries for the rest of the game... and your opponent will lose up to 9 Force! Not bad for a common, eh?

Qui-Gon already takes aliens down a notch. Add [[A Jedi's Focus]] to take them down two... or three...

Jedi [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] is [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s equal now. Use [[A Jedi's Focus]] to make him [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s superior &#150; and keep the Dark Lord out of your hair forever.
